title: How many multiracial students were enrolled in Bay Village City School District in 2023-24 school year?
text:
Paul Craft Ohio Superintendent of Public Instruction | https://sboe.ohio.gov/about-us/superintendent/01-superintendent
Paul Craft Ohio Superintendent of Public Instruction | https://sboe.ohio.gov/about-us/superintendent/01-superintendent
Ohio Department of Education & Workforce.
Data showed that Bay Village City School District welcomed 2,364 students during the 2023-24 school year. Among them, multiracial students made up 3.9% of the student body, making them the third most represented ethnicity in the district.
Bay Village City School District roughly covers five schools within Cuyahoga County and has its main office in Bay Village.
Among the five schools in Bay Village City School District, Bay Middle School recorded the highest enrollment of multiracial students in the 2023-24 school year, with a total of 32 students.
In 2022, Ohio saw an average student-to-teacher ratio of approximately 1:15, which is better than the national average of 1:16. This marks an improvement for the state, especially compared to 2016, when the ratio reached its decade-high at 16.1 students per teacher.
Despite the apparent improvement, this positive trend is overshadowed by a general decline in public school enrollments, which was accelerated by the pandemic. This decline, aligned with the steady number of teachers in the state over the last 10 years, has led to low student-to-teacher ratios.
Year | Total District Enrollment | Total Multiracial Students | Multiracial % |
---|---|---|---|
2023-24 | 2,364 | 92 | 3.9% |
2022-23 | 2,381 | 88 | 3.7% |
2021-22 | 2,424 | 85 | 3.5% |
